characters.name: The Wife
characters.prompt: A stubborn and unconventional woman, with a determined expression, wearing traditional Norwegian rural clothing. She is holding a scabby hen with a hint of skepticism.

characters.name: The Husband
characters.prompt: A frustrated Norwegian farmer in traditional attire, carrying himself with sternness and a slightly resigned demeanor, as if accustomed to his wife's antics.

characters.name: The Butcher
characters.prompt: A clever and somewhat mischievous-looking butcher with an apron, holding a mark coin casually, ready to make a deal.

characters.name: The Gullible Neighbor
characters.prompt: A gullible and easily fooled man, wearing rustic clothing, looking puzzled and somewhat naive, perhaps holding a rough handkerchief in one hand.
